shared: Use case: identity-preserve. Create a production-ready transparent pixel-art character sprite atlas for the existing Chinese garden game. Use the provided character card as IDENTITY AND COSTUME reference, and second image only as style/pose reference. Crisp pixel clusters and dark one-pixel outlines, chibi proportions matching Daiyu. Exactly 4 columns x 3 rows, evenly spaced non-overlapping equal cells, all complete figures centered, generous transparent cell gutters. No words, no labels, no furniture, no chairs, no beds, no shadows, no colored glow, no background. All sprites must have REAL alpha transparency. Read row-major: row1 standing facing viewer, standing facing away, standing profile facing screen-right, standing profile facing screen-left. Row2 seated facing viewer on an invisible normal-height stool, seated facing away, seated facing screen-right, seated facing screen-left. Row3 seated writing slightly leaning forward with hands in lap and no props, seated low on invisible stone stool side view, lying supine head upward eyes closed with no pillow/bed/blanket and fully visible body, standing facing viewer smiling. Same character, clothing, headsize and design throughout. Seated figures must visibly bend hips and knees, hanging lower legs; not standing silhouettes. Lying must look reclined. Retain all original identity colors and ornaments. No other characters.
baoyu: JIA BAOYU, youthful male, red forehead crown with red pompom, red-white embroidered hanfu, gold trim, jade pendant, black long hair, red tassels. Preserve his clearly youthful male identity, no blue Daiyu accessories.
baochai: XUE BAOCHAI, youthful female, dignified warm smile, black long hair in rounded ornate updo, small golden-yellow and white blossoms and gold ornament, green jade earrings and pendant, cream and golden-yellow embroidered hanfu, orange-gold sash.
